latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Langfuse Observability toolkit for OpenClaw agents.
- Provides automatic tracing for LLM calls, API calls, tool executions, and custom events.
- Includes cost tracking per model, session grouping, evaluation scoring, dashboard queries, and health monitoring.
- Offers importable tracing functions and a CLI for dashboard interaction.
- Supports daily observability reporting via Telegram.
